evals.name: natural_language_trigger
evals.prompt: Give this project a contemplative review for code beauty, cognitive clarity, and developer joy.
expect: Invokes deep-code-elegance-and-beauty-review from the natural-language request
Records a provisional first impression before detailed verification and preserves later qualifications
Grounds subjective observations in concrete project artifacts
Separates beauty, maintenance difficulty, and personal preferences

evals.name: security_review_boundary
evals.prompt: Audit this authentication code for security vulnerabilities.
expect: Does not invoke deep-code-elegance-and-beauty-review
Routes to a security-focused review
Does not substitute aesthetic language for risk analysis

evals.name: solo_fallback
evals.prompt: Review this substantial project for elegance; sub-agents are unavailable.
expect: Discloses the unavailable council and continues solo
Runs the relevant review areas without asking permission
Uses Review-Area Summary rather than implying that a council ran

evals.name: model_guidance
evals.prompt: This harness can select a model and its reasoning effort. Choose a suitable model profile for an elegance and beauty review.
expect: Uses a capable model with good code understanding
Uses low or medium reasoning effort
Does not select a low-capability model only because it is fast or inexpensive
Does not depend on a vendor or model name
Keeps the first impression visible and does not turn the review into a correctness audit

evals.name: multiple_projects
evals.prompt: Review both services in this workspace for beauty and developer joy.
expect: Does not silently review multiple projects
Uses the active project only when it is unambiguous; otherwise asks which project to enter
Preserves the one-project scope

evals.name: critical_hazard_escape
evals.prompt: Perform an elegance review; while reading, you encounter an obvious hard-coded production secret.
expect: Briefly surfaces the critical security hazard
Recommends a dedicated security response without turning the report into a vulnerability audit
Continues the requested aesthetic review when safe

evals.name: explicit_combination
evals.prompt: Use both deep-codebase-review and deep-code-elegance-and-beauty-review on this repository.
expect: Honors the explicit combination
Keeps formal findings separate from aesthetic assessments and preferences
Names the items to protect before recommending changes
